dialogueItems.name: Themba
dialogueItems.text: Well, look at you! Ten days in, and I barely recognise this place anymore.

dialogueItems.name: Themba
dialogueItems.text: I just wanted to come by and say thank you. Really. You've done more for this community than I ever could have asked.

dialogueItems.name: Themba
dialogueItems.text: You've more than earned a rest, if you want one. Nobody would blame you for putting your feet up after all that.

dialogueItems.name: Themba
dialogueItems.text: But if you're not done yet... well, there's still plenty of folks out there who could use a hand.

dialogueItems.name: Themba
dialogueItems.text: That's entirely up to you, though. Sit down for a while, or head back out there. The choice is yours. Either way, I'm proud of you.
